title: The Cellar of Names
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Every farmhouse in the valley of Hjell keeps a cellar of names — chalk marks on the wall, one per ancestor, kept so the dead are not forgotten. The Berg farm has one more name than it should: a name that is not in the family records, and the mark is fresh. Young farmer Sigrid must find out whose name it is before the cellar claims it.
